summary: DirectX surface/texture sub-constructor (size 0x30): calls DirectXTextureCreationWithMipmapChain to initialize the base object, then installs vtable off_5ADDAC at this+0x0 and returns this.

operations.description: Calls DirectXTextureCreationWithMipmapChain(this, a2, 0x30, 1) to initialize the DirectX surface base object with a mipmap chain and size 0x30.
Writes the address of vtable off_5ADDAC into this at offset 0x0.

unresolved: Meaning of the second parameter a2 passed through to DirectXTextureCreationWithMipmapChain is unknown.
Semantics of the 0x30 size argument (object allocation size vs texture dimension) are not established.
